job_record_fields.source: str  human-readable source label, e.g. 'ByteDance official careers'
job_record_fields.source_job_id: str  employer's own posting id when available else ''
job_record_fields.company: str  employer display name (original language ok)
job_record_fields.title: str  posting title verbatim
job_record_fields.location: str  mainland China city (北京/上海/深圳/广州/杭州/...)
job_record_fields.role_family: enum  ai_product | general_product | data_product | platform_enterprise_product | strategy_growth_fintech_product | mismatched_control
job_record_fields.ai_subdomain: str|null  only for ai_product/mismatched; one of the §8 subdomains or null
job_record_fields.language: enum  zh | en   (classified: zh when substantive CJK chars >= Latin alpha chars)
job_record_fields.job_url: str  canonical public URL of the posting
job_record_fields.job_description_raw: str  verbatim JD text (responsibilities + requirements). NOT translated, NOT reconstructed.
job_record_fields.responsibilities_text: str  verbatim responsibilities section if separable else ''
job_record_fields.requirements_text: str  verbatim requirements section if separable else ''
job_record_fields.preferred_requirements_text: str  verbatim '优先/加分/preferred' block if present else ''
job_record_fields.education_requirement: str  verbatim only if JD states it; else '' (never inferred)
job_record_fields.experience_requirement: str  verbatim only if JD states it; else '' (never inferred)
job_record_fields.graduation_year_requirement: str  verbatim only if JD states it; else ''
job_record_fields.collected_at: ISO-8601  when the JD text was captured
job_record_fields.collector: str  who/what captured it (human name or tool)
job_record_fields.access_note: str  how it was accessed; MUST record any block encountered

requirement_candidate_fields.source_text: str  verbatim JD span this requirement came from
requirement_candidate_fields.source_section: enum  responsibilities | requirements | preferred | education | experience | other
requirement_candidate_fields.requirement_type: enum  eligibility | matchable | knowledge | subjective   (Evidence-Verifiability, NOT keywords)

prohibited: inferred hard requirements not stated in the JD
finalist-matcher output used for requirement extraction or ground truth
